Name: N'astirh
Description: N'Astirh was a demon that lived in Limbo. He has proven to be a master manipulator that enjoys the corruption of those he chooses as his targets. While Illyana Rasputin was trapped in Limbo, he pretended to help her by defending her against S'ym. All the while, manipulating her to further his own agendas. This eventually led to him and his demons to invade earth. During this time, N'astirh tried to wreck as much havok on earth as he could. He also made a pact with Cameron Hodge, promising him immortality. Besides that, he awoke the dark side of Madelyne Pryor through her dreams, causing her to become the evil Goblyn Queen. Then manipulated her further while posing as her servant.
